project_type: Full-stack AI email outreach platform - FastAPI backend + Next.js 16 frontend
build_system: pip + npm, Docker Compose for orchestration
test_framework: No test infrastructure exists yet. Backend uses pytest conventions, frontend uses jest/vitest.
build_command: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt && cd ../frontend && npm install && npm run build
test_command: cd backend && python -m pytest tests/ (once created); cd ../frontend && npm run build (type-check)
verification_instructions: 1. Install backend deps and run uvicorn to confirm startup. 2. Install frontend deps and run npm run build to confirm no TS errors. 3. Confirm docker-compose.yml is valid YAML.
setup_instructions: Backend: cd backend && pip install -r requirements.txt. Frontend: cd frontend && npm install.
environment_constraints: Open internet available. No running Docker daemon needed for validation - use pip install + npm build as verification. SQLite used for local dev (no Postgres needed to run).
contribution_requirements: Commit to a new branch (not main). Code should follow existing patterns.
key_patterns: Backend: FastAPI routers in app/api/, services in app/services/, SQLAlchemy models in models.py, Pydantic schemas in schemas.py. Frontend: Next.js App Router, TanStack Query hooks in lib/hooks.ts, types in lib/types.ts, shadcn/ui components in components/ui/. Dark theme with glassmorphism design.
directory_structure: Root: backend/ (FastAPI Python), frontend/ (Next.js TS), docker-compose.yml, .env.example. Backend: app/ with main.py, config.py, database.py, models.py, schemas.py, security.py, celery_app.py, tasks.py; app/api/ with routers; app/services/ with business logic. Frontend: src/app/ (pages), src/components/ (UI), src/lib/ (api client, hooks, types, utils).
